title: Townspeople claim 1992 UFO crash recovered by Brookhaven National Lab
place_text: Brookhaven National Laboratory, Long Island, New York

tellings.quote: And um in '92 a lot of the town's people around uh Brook Haven said that there was a UFO crash that was actually collected by the facility there as well.
Now, um I really like the '9s Brook Haven crash. I think that's really fantast.
tellings.difference: Dates it only to the 1990s and points to sheriff testimony rather than to townspeople.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the claimed early-1990s UFO crash at Brookhaven, Long Island.

tellings.quote: I believe there's a crash, a UFO crash in 1992 where everybody in that town, South Haven, um basically saw the National Labs itself recover this craft, collect it and like take it into the the national labs.
tellings.difference: Names the town as South Haven and says everybody in town saw the lab collect the craft.
tellings.link_reason: The same 1992 UFO crash that townspeople say Brookhaven National Lab recovered.

as_told.title: 1992 UFO crash recovered by Brookhaven National Lab
as_told.place_text: South Haven / Brookhaven National Laboratory, New York

tellings.quote: Well, apparently there was a UFO crash collected by the lab itself in 1992.
tellings.difference: Told by the host as a bare claim ('apparently'), with no townspeople named as the source.
tellings.link_reason: The same 1992 UFO crash said to have been recovered by Brookhaven National Lab.

as_told.title: UFO crash recovered by Brookhaven National Lab
as_told.place_text: Brookhaven National Laboratory, Long Island, New York

tellings.quote: >> And there's a famous there's a famous crash in the US at South Haven right near next to Brook Haven National Lab. That's that's where our largest particle accelerator is. So that's our CERN equivalent in Long Island. And you have the police chief there and a bunch of local residents say that it was collected by Brook Haven.
tellings.difference: No year given; credits the local police chief as a witness and calls Brookhaven the US equivalent of CERN.
tellings.link_reason: The same crash at South Haven next to Brookhaven, with townspeople saying the lab collected the craft.

as_told.title: South Haven crash collected by Brookhaven National Lab
as_told.place_text: South Haven, Long Island, New York, USA

tellings.quote: There was even a UFO crash right next to [music] Brook Haven National Labs.
tellings.difference: Gives no year, no townspeople witnesses and no claim that the lab recovered the craft; it only says the crash was right next to the lab.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of a UFO crash at or beside Brookhaven National Laboratory on Long Island.

as_told.title: UFO crash next to Brookhaven National Lab

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels says that in 1992 many people living near Brookhaven National Laboratory, a government science lab on Long Island, New York, said a UFO crashed and the lab collected it. In other retellings he dates it only to the 1990s and points to a sheriff's account, or names the town as South Haven and says everybody there saw the lab take the craft inside. If true, it would mean a national lab recovered a crashed craft in front of local witnesses.
